entries.title: Coal Echoes  |  Narrative Exploration Game
entries.meta: 2026  ·  In development  ·  Unity 6, HDRP, C#, Blender
bullets: Designed a four-level first person exploration game about 1970s working class memories at an abandoned coal plant; built photography, album, scrapbook, and inspection systems for object discovery through the camera.
Used an AI agent through Blender MCP to assist with parametric modeling and texture baking for industrial assets, including cableway structures and a guardhouse, then integrated them into Unity.

Built terrain from USGS elevation data in MapMagic with an offline Gradient Terrain Authoring transition; created HDRP sandstorm, heat haze, and runtime newspaper halftone effects (halftone adapted from Daniel Ilett, MIT).

entries.title: Project Fireflies  |  Interactive Light Installation
bullets: Programmed 420 LEDs across three swarms, using radar and light sensors to translate visitor movement and human light sources into firefly disturbance and synchronization.
Implemented two independently responsive zones, one ambient swarm, and a UDP interface for sending Unity synchronization commands during development and debugging.

entries.title: Seafloor Revival  |  GMTK Game Jam 2025
entries.meta: July to August 2025  ·  UI Development and Art Integration  ·  Unity, C#
bullets: Built all game UI and related C# behavior, integrated interface art in a six person team, and contributed to a released browser prototype of a 2.5D underwater building game.

entries.title: Mooncake  |  Interactive Graphics
bullets: Built a Three.js mooncake scene for the Mid Autumn Festival with STL models, shadowed spotlighting, and drifting star particles; added live controls for light, camera orbit, and particles, documented in a technical report.

entries.title: IQVIA  |  Technology Solutions Intern
bullets: Wrote and maintained 100+ pages of user guides for a pharmaceutical WeChat Mini Program upgrade, covering two user types, four scenarios, and three device contexts.
Performed user acceptance testing and reported 10+ defects in Jira with reproduction steps; organized 1,000+ data tags into a three level hierarchy for user filtering.

entries.title: Human Computer Interaction in Indie Games
bullets: Analyzed implicit guidance, environmental storytelling, and player attachment in FAR Lone Sails; published in Lecture Notes in Education Psychology and Public Media, vol. 18, pp. 194 to 199.

entries.title: Coal Echoes 煤火回声  |  叙事探索游戏
bullets: 以废弃煤厂为舞台，围绕 1970 年代特定时代下的工人阶级记忆设计四个关卡的第一人称探索体验，搭建摄影、相册、手账编辑与物品检视系统，实现通过相机发现物品的交互。
通过 Blender MCP，由 AI Agent 辅助完成索道、门卫室等工业资产的参数化建模与材质烘焙，并导入 Unity 场景。
基于 USGS 实测高程数据在 MapMagic 中搭建地形，并以 Gradient Terrain Authoring 离线求解地形过渡；在 HDRP 中实现沙尘、热浪与运行时报纸半调效果（半调算法改写自 Daniel Ilett，MIT）。

entries.title: Project Fireflies  |  萤火虫交互装置
bullets: 编程控制三组共 420 颗 LED，通过雷达与光照传感器捕捉参与者的移动与人为光源，映射为萤火虫灯群的扰动和同步行为。
实现两个独立感应区域与一组自然闪烁灯群，并提供开发调试用的 UDP 接口，可由 Unity 发送同步控制指令。

entries.title: Mooncake  |  交互图形项目
entries.meta: 2025 年 2 月至 4 月  ·  Three.js、JavaScript
bullets: 使用 Three.js 搭建中秋月饼场景，导入 STL 月饼与餐盘模型，实现聚光灯阴影与漂浮星光粒子，提供灯光、相机环绕与粒子的实时调节面板，并撰写技术报告说明实现过程。

执行用户验收测试，在 Jira 提交 10 多项缺陷及复现步骤；梳理 1,000 多个数据标签，建立支持用户筛选的三层分类。
